publication.title: Limiting neutrino magnetic moments with Borexino Phase-II solar neutrino data

prospective_benchmark_branch.selection_rationale: Use a single mass-basis transition component to avoid treating the scalar effective limit as a flavor-basis matrix element and to avoid an unnecessary flavor-to-mass magnetic-moment mapping. mu_12 has the tightest published individual bound and equals the published effective-limit scale.
prospective_benchmark_branch.allowed_terminal_use: A boundary/envelope benchmark may set |mu_12| to or below the published 90% CL upper limit if that boundary-use semantics is preregistered before propagation results are seen.
prospective_benchmark_branch.prohibited_inference: The upper bound is not a measured central value and does not imply a nonzero neutrino magnetic moment. Choosing a Majorana benchmark is a conditional model branch, not evidence that neutrinos are Majorana.

basis_guard.existing_preflight_representation: synthetic e-mu transition matrix in flavor basis
basis_guard.terminal_rule: Do not insert the mass-basis Borexino number directly into the existing flavor-basis magnetic block. Either implement the single mu_12 interaction in a common mass-basis representation with all other Hamiltonian terms transformed consistently, or freeze an exact unitary transformation and demonstrate probability-level basis invariance before use.
